content:
Three invoices need attention: NAT-2007 (status AUDIT_REQUIRED; flagged as a possible duplicate of NAT-2006), RAJ-2009 (status AUDIT_REQUIRED; flagged as a possible duplicate of RAJ-2008), and VPI-OUT-2014 (status NEEDS_REVIEW; has a tax_mismatch error: "Subtotal (409500.00) + Tax (73710.00) does not match Grand Total (483850.00)"). Please review the duplicate warnings for NAT-2007 and RAJ-2009 and correct/confirm the tax/grand-total discrepancy on VPI-OUT-2014.

### Query Results

invoice_number | vendor_name | customer_name | flow_direction | status | grand_total | currency | sa_alerts
--- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | ---
NAT-2007 | National MRO Traders |  | INBOUND | AUDIT_REQUIRED | 79956.80 | INR | Possible duplicate: National MRO Traders invoice NAT-2006 (ID: 86f1559a-ab03-4c07-b1f3-7453db53aeb9) has the same date and total (79,956.80) but a different number (NAT-2007). Check whether this is a re-issue.
RAJ-2009 | Rajesh Steel Corporation |  | INBOUND | AUDIT_REQUIRED | 437190.00 | INR | Possible duplicate: Rajesh Steel Corporation invoice RAJ-2008 (ID: d5869da2-b3bc-4d41-9356-2c6a02352616) has the same date and total (437,190.00) but a different number (RAJ-2009). Check whether this is a re-issue.
VPI-OUT-2014 | Vishwa Precision Industries Pvt Ltd | Kaveri Auto Components Pvt Ltd | OUTBOUND | NEEDS_REVIEW | 483850.00 | INR | Subtotal (409500.00) + Tax (73710.00) does not match Grand Total (483850.00)
generated_sql: SELECT invoice_number, vendor_name, customer_name, flow_direction, status, grand_total, currency, sa_alerts FROM invoice WHERE tenant_id = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' AND (status IN ('AUDIT_REQUIRED', 'NEEDS_REVIEW') OR (sa_alerts IS NOT NULL AND CAST(sa_alerts AS TEXT) NOT IN ('[]', 'null', ''))) ORDER BY invoice_number
